verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's official site explicitly says you can download it and 'replace your current operating system', calling it 'easy to install in place of Windows'. The help docs add step-by-step installation tutorials and a guide to creating a bootable USB stick, which together cover the replacement-install path. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the replace-OS install experience, and in-depth documented detail on the disk-wipe and partitioning steps (the evidence is mostly marketing copy and doc titles).
